name: revenant
description: The Revenant citadel — marketplace of Revenant Agent Skill packs. Each pack installs as one plugin; every skill inside stands alone.

plugins.name: foundation
plugins.description: Nine standalone wrights: skillwright (skills & packs), promptwright (prompts), commwright (messages), agentwright (agent specs), rigwright (standing Claude config), lorewright (research verdicts & playbooks), evalwright (eval suites), brandwright (brand & voice), tokenwright (token footprint). Each routes on its own description and works alone; together they cover the full build-audit-ship loop.
